text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 你好，欢迎收听“地道简单英语”。
zh_hant: 你好，歡迎收聽“地道簡單英語”。

text: We're back with another conversation in Easy English to help you learn.
zh: 我们带着另一段简单英语对话回来了，帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 我們帶著另一段簡單英語對話回來了，幫助你學習。

text: I'm Georgie.
And I'm Neil.
Don't forget that there's a video version
zh: 别忘了还有一个视频版本
zh_hant: 別忘了還有一個影片版本

text: of this podcast on our website,
zh: 这个播客在我们的网站上，
zh_hant: 這個播客在我們的網站上，

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
You can read along with the subtitles and download
zh: 你可以跟着字幕阅读，并下载
zh_hant: 你可以跟著字幕閱讀，並下載

text: a free worksheet.
Hello, Neil, how are you doing?
zh: 你好，尼尔，你最近怎么样？
zh_hant: 你好，尼爾，你最近怎麼樣？

text: Hi, Georgie, yeah, I'm fine.
How are you?
Yes, I'm very well too, thank you.
Today, Neil, in this conversation, we're talking about moving
zh: 今天，尼尔，在这次对话中，我们要聊搬家
zh_hant: 今天，尼爾，在這次對話中，我們要聊搬家

text: house.
So, when was the last time you moved house?
zh: 那你上次搬家是什么时候？
zh_hant: 那你上次搬家是什麼時候？

text: Oh, I moved house probably 12 years ago.
Oh, wow.
And why did you move to where you live now?
zh: 那你为什么搬到你现在住的地方？
zh_hant: 那你為什麼搬到你現在住的地方？

text: Because my family was getting bigger.
More children need more space,
zh: 更多孩子需要更多空间，
zh_hant: 更多孩子需要更多空間，

text: so we moved to somewhere bigger
zh: 所以我们搬到了一个更大的地方
zh_hant: 所以我們搬到了一個更大的地方

text: and further out of London.
How about you?
I rent my flat, and the place I was living before,
zh: 我租公寓，我之前住的地方，
zh_hant: 我租公寓，我之前住的地方，

text: the owners of the place wanted to sell the house,
so I needed to move because I couldn't live there anymore.
zh: 所以我需要搬家，因为我不能再住在那儿了。
zh_hant: 所以我需要搬家，因為我不能再住在那兒了。

text: And also, my friend had this flat
zh: 而且，我的朋友有这间公寓
zh_hant: 而且，我的朋友有這間公寓

text: and he was offering me very cheap rent,
so that's why I live there.
But I'm very happy there because it's between two
zh: 但是我在那儿很开心，因为它位于两个
zh_hant: 但是我在那兒很開心，因為它位於兩個

text: really nice parks.
It has good transport links.
And yeah, it was a good decision.
And how was the move itself?
The move was actually very easy
because I don't have many possessions.
I'm a bit of a minimalist.
The reason is because I moved country.
So I just didn't really have many things to bring
zh: 所以我真的没什么可带的
zh_hant: 所以我真的沒什麼可帶的

text: back to the UK.
So I didn't need a big van or anything.
zh: 所以我也不需要大货车什么的。
zh_hant: 所以我也不需要大貨車什麼的。

text: I just ordered a taxi and put all of my bags
zh: 我就叫了一辆出租车，把所有的包
zh_hant: 我就叫了一輛計程車，把所有的包

text: in the taxi,
and it was very easy.
And what about you?
It was the opposite of that.
Oh, no.
We had a removal van and some removal men
zh: 我们有一辆搬家卡车，还有几个搬运工
zh_hant: 我們有一輛搬家卡車，還有幾個搬運工

text: who came and packed everything up in boxes,
zh: 来把所有东西包装进箱子，
zh_hant: 來把所有東西包裝進箱子，

text: to make sure that things were easy to carry
into the van and also that they didn't get damaged.
zh: 进卡车，而且也不会损坏。
zh_hant: 進卡車，而且也不會損壞。

text: And then they drove all of our stuff
zh: 然后他们把所有东西开车
zh_hant: 然後他們把所有東西開車

text: to my new house.
Yeah.
Did you have any fragile bits?
So fragile means that it's easy to break, not very strong,
zh: 易碎的意思是容易打碎，不够结实，
zh_hant: 易碎的意思是容易打碎，不夠結實，

text: plates and things.
zh: 比如盘子和之类的东西。
zh_hant: 比如盤子和之類的東西。

text: Did you have?
Yes, those things had to be wrapped
zh: 有的，那些东西必须包好
zh_hant: 有的，那些東西必須包好

text: and protected,
otherwise they would break.
Yes.
And did you have to move furniture as well?
Yeah, we had to move sofas
and cupboards and wardrobes
and heavy things like that.
Yeah, does sound different to my experience, doesn't it.
zh: 听起来和我的经历很不一样，对吧。
zh_hant: 聽起來和我的經歷很不一樣，對吧。

text: I didn't have any furniture to take.
Do you find moving house exciting,
zh: 你觉得搬家令人兴奋吗，
zh_hant: 你覺得搬家令人興奮嗎，

text: scary?
How do you feel about moving house?
I think it's both.
It's exciting and scary.
It's exciting because this is going to be your new
zh: 兴奋是因为这将是你新的
zh_hant: 興奮是因為這將是你新的

text: life,
or where your new life will happen,
zh: 或者说你的新生活将在那里发生，
zh_hant: 或者說你的新生活將在那裡發生，

text: but it's also scary because you don't know
zh: 但也很害怕，因为你不知道
zh_hant: 但也很害怕，因為你不知道

text: what that's going to be like.
You don't know what your neighbors are going to be like.
zh: 你也不知道你的邻居会是什么样。
zh_hant: 你也不知道你的鄰居會是什麼樣。

text: That's very true.
You don't know what your new friends are going to be like, yes.
zh: 你也不知道你的新朋友会是什么样，是的。
zh_hant: 你也不知道你的新朋友會是什麼樣，是的。

text: So there's lots of things that you don't know,
zh: 所以有很多你不知道的事情，
zh_hant: 所以有很多你不知道的事情，

text: and that's scary but also exciting.
zh: 这既让人害怕又让人兴奋。
zh_hant: 這既讓人害怕又讓人興奮。

text: Yeah, a lot of uncertainty for sure.
zh: 是的，肯定有很多不确定性。
zh_hant: 是的，肯定有很多不確定性。

text: Yeah, I think it can depend.
It depends if you're moving somewhere better or worse.
zh: 取决于你是搬到更好的地方还是更差的地方。
zh_hant: 取決於你是搬到更好的地方還是更差的地方。

text: But yeah, I was quite excited when I moved,
zh: 但是，嗯，我搬家的时候还是挺兴奋的，
zh_hant: 但是，嗯，我搬家的時候還是挺興奮的，

text: because I knew that my new flat
zh: 因为我知道我的新公寓
zh_hant: 因為我知道我的新公寓

text: had a nice outdoor terrace.
zh: 有一个不错的户外露台。
zh_hant: 有一個不錯的戶外露臺。

text: As I said, we were close to parks and stuff, so I was excited.
zh: 就像我说的，我们离公园什么的很近，所以我很兴奋。
zh_hant: 就像我說的，我們離公園什麼的很近，所以我很興奮。

text: So Georgie, if you are planning a move,
zh: 那么乔吉，如果你计划搬家，
zh_hant: 那麼喬吉，如果你計劃搬家，

text: what do you need to do to prepare?
Well, you need to do things
like setting up Wi-Fi in the new house,
zh: 比如在新房子安装无线网络，
zh_hant: 比如在新房子安裝無線網路，

text: other bills like electricity
and heating, gas.
You need to put your name on the accounts.
zh: 你需要把名字登记在这些账户上。
zh_hant: 你需要把名字登記在這些賬戶上。

text: You need to plan what you're going to take.
So when you move,
it's a really good time to look at all of your possessions
zh: 这是个好时机来审视你所有的物品
zh_hant: 這是個好時機來審視你所有的物品

text: and think, what do I need?
Maybe I can get rid of stuff.
zh: 也许我可以处理掉一些东西。
zh_hant: 也許我可以處理掉一些東西。

text: So throw stuff away.
Have you got any other ideas?
What else can you do to prepare for a move?
zh: 还有什么可以做的来准备搬家？
zh_hant: 還有什麼可以做的來準備搬家？

text: You can hire a removal company
zh: 你可以雇一家搬家公司
zh_hant: 你可以僱一家搬家公司

text: or van if you're doing it yourself,
zh: 或者租辆货车，如果你自己动手的话，
zh_hant: 或者租輛貨車，如果你自己動手的話，

text: if you need to transport your stuff to your new house.
zh: 如果你需要把东西运到新家。
zh_hant: 如果你需要把東西運到新家。

text: Yeah, and you can't just use A taxi, yeah,
zh: 是的，你不能只用一辆出租车，嗯，
zh_hant: 是的，你不能只用一輛計程車，嗯，

text: sounds like a lot of work.
I don't want to move anytime soon.
No, me neither.
No.
OK,
let's recap the language we heard during the conversation.
zh: 让我们回顾一下对话中听到的词汇。
zh_hant: 讓我們回顧一下對話中聽到的詞彙。

text: We heard possessions, which are the things that you own or have.
zh: 我们听到了 possessions，指的是你拥有的东西。
zh_hant: 我們聽到了 possessions，指的是你擁有的東西。

text: For example, my phone and my clothes are my possessions.
zh: 例如，我的手机和衣服就是我的 possessions。
zh_hant: 例如，我的手機和衣服就是我的 possessions。

text: We talked about removal vans.
A removal van is a large vehicle
zh: Removal van 是一种大型车辆
zh_hant: Removal van 是一種大型車輛

text: that people put your possessions
zh: 人们把你的东西装进去
zh_hant: 人們把你的東西裝進去

text: into to go from one home to another.
zh: 从一个家搬到另一个家。
zh_hant: 從一個家搬到另一個家。

text: And the company is called a removals company
zh: 这家公司叫做 removals company
zh_hant: 這家公司叫做 removals company

text: or removals firm.
We heard packing,
and packing is where you put your own things into boxes
zh: packing 就是把你自己的东西放进箱子里
zh_hant: packing 就是把你自己的東西放進箱子裡

text: so that a removal firm can take them to your new home.
zh: 这样搬家公司就能带到你的新家。
zh_hant: 這樣搬家公司就能帶到你的新家。

text: And we heard fragile.
is an adjective which describes something that can break
zh: 它是一个形容词，描述容易碎的
zh_hant: 它是一個形容詞，描述容易碎的

text: easily,
for example, glass.
is fragile.
That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这就是本期“地道简单英语”的全部内容。
zh_hant: 這就是本期“地道簡單英語”的全部內容。

text: Don't forget to test what you've learnt using the free
zh: 别忘了用我们网站上免费的
zh_hant: 別忘了用我們網站上免費的

text: worksheet on our website.
zh: 工作表来测试你学到的内容。
zh_hant: 工作表來測試你學到的內容。

text: Go to bbclearningenglish.com.
We'll be back next week with another conversation in Easy English.
zh: 我们下周会回来，带另一段简单英语对话。
zh_hant: 我們下週會回來，帶另一段簡單英語對話。

text: Bye for now.
Goodbye.
